argv: $ErrorActionPreference='Continue'; $root='E:\WebAIBridge'; $head=((& git.exe -C $root rev-parse HEAD)|Out-String).Trim(); Write-Output ('LIVE_HEAD='+$head); Write-Output ('DIRTY_TRACKED='+(@(& git.exe -C $root status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=no).Count)); Write-Output ('SERVER_HASH='+(Get-FileHash -LiteralPath (Join-Path $root 'app\server.js') -Algorithm SHA256).Hash); try{$h=Invoke-RestMethod 'http://127.0.0.1:17448/api/health' -TimeoutSec 3;Write-Output ('HTTP_HEALTH='+$h.state)}catch{Write-Output 'HTTP_HEALTH=UNAVAILABLE'}; try{$c=Invoke-RestMethod 'http://127.0.0.1:17448/api/projects/control-plane/cutover-r42/status' -TimeoutSec 3;Write-Output ('R42_HOLD='+$c.cutoverState.holdActive);Write-Output ('R42_STATUS='+$c.cutoverState.status)}catch{Write-Output 'R42_STATUS=UNAVAILABLE'}; try{$a=Invoke-RestMethod 'http://127.0.0.1:17448/api/supervisor-watchdog/agent-assignments' -TimeoutSec 3;Write-Output ('ASSIGNMENT_QUEUED='+@($a.assignments|Where-Object {$_.state -eq 'queued'}).Count)}catch{Write-Output 'ASSIGNMENTS=UNAVAILABLE'}; $backupDir=Join-Path $root 'app\data\backups'; if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $backupDir){$d=Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $backupDir -Directory -Filter 'r42-cutover-*' | Sort-Object LastWriteTimeUtc -Descending | Select-Object -First 1; if($d){Write-Output ('LATEST_BACKUP_MANIFEST_EXISTS='+(Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $d.FullName 'rollback-manifest.json')));Write-Output ('LATEST_BACKUP_NAME='+$d.Name)}}
